  •  NON - AGENDA ITEM  - at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while

9. NEW BUSINESS

  A. REQUEST FROM TEMPLE CITY AMATEUR SOFTBALL ASSOCIATION
  (TCASA) FOR RESERVED USE OF THE SOFTBALL FIELD AT LIVE
  OAK PARK

  As required by the Agreement for use of the Athletic Fields, the
  Commission is requested to review and approve the request for reserved
  use of the softball in  - field at Live Oak Park for fall practices from August
  – November 202 6 .

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Director of Parks and Recreation

  Recommendation:  Approve the request from TCASA for reserved use
  of the softball in - field at Live Oak Park from August
  – November 202  6 for fall practices with the
  conditions stated in the staff report and waive the

  B. REQUEST FROM AYSO FOR RESERVED USE OF THE ATHLETIC FIELDS
  AT LIVE OAK PARK AND HANGING SPONSOR BANNERS

  As required by the Agreement for use of the Athletic Fields, the
  Commission is requested to review and approve the request for reserved
  use of the athletic fields at Live Oak Park for fall practices and games from
  August – December 202  6 . Additionally, AYSO is requesting to hang
  sponsor banners at Live Oak Park for their 202  6 fall soccer season.

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Director of Parks and Recreation

  Recommendation:  Approve the request from AYSO for use of athletic
  fields, waive the 51% residency requirement for
  reserved use of the fields, and to hang sponsor
  banners at Live Oak Park for the 202  6 fall season.

  C. JUNE PROGRAMMING REPORT

  Recommendation:  Receive and file.
